headline: Bronx DJ's Party Turntable Trick Sparks a New Musical Movement
dispatch: A birthday party at 1520 Sedgwick Avenue in the South Bronx turned into the birth of a genre on the night of August 11, 1973. DJ Kool Herc extended the percussion break of a record by switching between two copies, keeping the crowd dancing. The technique, soon called the breakbeat, gave rise to the art form that became hip hop.
answer: DJ Kool Herc's party launches hip hop music, 1973
